E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director reported increase numbers of participation
in youth sports programs.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula commended the efforts of the Mayor for highlighting new businesses;
extended condolences to the family of Sonia Martinez, and Lupe Cabrera; thanked staff for the
basketball program being well organized; and announced that ABCUSD will hold Town Hall meetings on
February 7, 2024 and February 15, 2024, on the school facilities capacities and declining enrollment.

Councilmember Roa extended condolences to the family of Sonia Martinez; requested staff to look into
a business recognition program; congratulated Jesus Mendoza on his retirement; and congratulated the
Perez family for the Fire Academy Invitation.

Councilmember Del Rio extended condolences to the family of Sonia Martinez; and thanked staff for the
great work they do for the basketball program.
